<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 460 300" width="460" height="300">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="460" height="300" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round">
    <!-- inclined plane -->
    <polygon points="120,240 400,240 120,78"/>
    <!-- smooth pulley at top of plane -->
    <circle cx="120" cy="78" r="20"/>
    <!-- 4.0 kg block on the plane -->
    <path d="M 313.4 190 L 261.4 160 L 281.4 125.36 L 333.4 155.36 Z"/>
    <!-- string from block over pulley, parallel to the plane -->
    <line x1="271.4" y1="142.68" x2="130" y2="60.68"/>
    <!-- string down to the hanging mass -->
    <line x1="100" y1="78" x2="100" y2="170"/>
    <!-- 3.0 kg hanging mass -->
    <rect x="85" y="170" width="30" height="36"/>
    <!-- angle arc at the bottom of the plane -->
    <path d="M 360 240 A 40 40 0 0 1 365.36 220" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#000000">
    <text x="297" y="162" text-anchor="middle">4.0 kg</text>
    <text x="78" y="194" text-anchor="end">3.0 kg</text>
    <text x="344" y="229" text-anchor="middle">30°</text>
    <text x="230" y="290" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Fig. 1.1</text>
  </g>
</svg>
